interaction.user_prompt:
Review the uncommitted changes on branch `finish-phase0-high` in /run/media/meirk/storage_2/projects/double_manager/twin2 (`git diff` against HEAD; the base is branch `render-errors`). Read CLAUDE.md for the project conventions (MVU, commands return messages, errors via reportError, IsParent rules, plan → resolve → execute).

What the change does (closes the last High bugs of Phase 0 in "Twin — Roadmap.md"):
1. `fs.go` `moveFile`: tries `rename` (a package var so tests can simulate EXDEV); if src is a dir and dst an existing real dir → `mergeDir` (moves entries one by one recursively, then removes src); on EXDEV → `moveAcrossDevices`: copy (symlink/dir/file), `syncFS` (unix.Syncfs on dst's dir) and only then `os.RemoveAll(src)`; on copy failure removes dst only if it did not exist before.
2. `copyFile` now Lstat-checks for a regular file (a FIFO would block on open), writes to `os.CreateTemp` next to dst, chmods, checks Close, sets mtime, renames into place; temp is removed on any error (named return + defer).
3. `copyDir` creates dirs 0700 while filling (so read-only sources work), then applies source mode and mtime only to directories it created (merge targets untouched).
4. `update.go`: `!m.isFavoritesOpen` added to the guard before pane delegation (favorites popup leaked keys to the pane).
5. Tests in fs_test.go / update_test.go, incl. an opt-in real cross-device test via TWIN_XDEV_DIR. go.mod promotes golang.org/x/sys to direct.

Please check especially: correctness/data-safety of the move fallback and the merge (any path where data can be lost, e.g. dst cleanup, symlinks at dst, partial merges, RemoveAll on src), the temp-file/defer error handling in copyFile, behaviour changes from atomic replace (hard links, dst symlinks, ownership), test quality (global `rename` swap, t.Cleanup), and idiomatic Go. Run gofmt, go vet, staticcheck if available, and go test. Report findings with file:line and concrete fixes, ranked by severity. Do not edit files.
